title: Sparkly pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='sparkleGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <!-- top-left sparkle -->
    <path d='M18 10 L20 16 L26 18 L20 20 L18 26 L16 20 L10 18 L16 16 Z' opacity='0.95'/>
    <!-- top-right sparkle -->
    <path d='M82 14 L83.5 19 L88 20 L83.5 21.5 L82 26 L80.5 21.5 L76 20 L80.5 19 Z' opacity='0.95'/>
    <!-- left sparkle -->
    <path d='M12 52 L13.5 57 L18 58 L13.5 59.5 L12 64 L10.5 59.5 L6 58 L10.5 57 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
    <!-- right sparkle -->
    <path d='M88 50 L89.5 55 L94 56 L89.5 57.5 L88 62 L86.5 57.5 L82 56 L86.5 55 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
    <!-- bottom sparkle -->
    <path d='M50 82 L52 88 L58 90 L52 92 L50 98 L48 92 L42 90 L48 88 Z' opacity='0.95'/>
    <!-- small extra sparkles -->
    <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='2' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='34' r='1.8' opacity='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='74' r='1.6' opacity='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='72' r='1.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Scissors - left blade (pointing up-left) -->
  <g>
    <!-- blade -->
    <path d='M42 48 L22 18 L26 16 L46 44 Z' fill='#a8d8f0' stroke='#d4eefc' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- blade highlight -->
    <path d='M24 20 L42 44' stroke='#e8f7ff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <ellipse cx='47' cy='55' rx='11' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#e05c8a' stroke-width='4.5' transform='rotate(-40 47 55)'/>
    <!-- handle highlight -->
    <ellipse cx='47' cy='55' rx='11' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#ff8cb3' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-40 47 55)' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Scissors - right blade (pointing up-right) -->
  <g>
    <!-- blade -->
    <path d='M58 48 L78 18 L74 16 L54 44 Z' fill='#a8d8f0' stroke='#d4eefc' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- blade highlight -->
    <path d='M76 20 L58 44' stroke='#e8f7ff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <ellipse cx='53' cy='55' rx='11' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#e05c8a' stroke-width='4.5' transform='rotate(40 53 55)'/>
    <!-- handle highlight -->
    <ellipse cx='53' cy='55' rx='11' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#ff8cb3' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(40 53 55)' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#c0c8d0' stroke='#e8eef5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#e8eef5'/>

  <!-- Blade edges (cutting edges) with lighter contrast -->
  <path d='M25 17 L46 46' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M75 17 L54 46' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
